defendant: MEGAN CATANA A/K/A MEGAN S. CATANA, ET AL
description:
PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: F-08880-23
SHERIFF’S NO.: 26000197
Plaintiff:
SERVIS ONE, INC. DBA BSI FINANCIAL SERVICES
Vs
Defendant:
MEGAN CATANA A/K/A MEGAN S. CATANA, ET AL
By virtue of the above stated ALIAS WRIT OF EXECUTION to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: 1 FERRO DRIVE SEWELL, NJ 08080 and BLOCK: 21.02 LOT: 1
ALL THAT CERTAIN LAND AND PREEMISES SITUATED IN THE TOWNSHIP OF WASHINGTON, COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER, STATE OF NEW JERSEY, BEING MORE PARTICULARLY DESCRIBED AS FOLLOWS:
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 151.23FT x 218FT x 79.52FT x 44.35FT x 218.76FT x 30FT
NEAREST CROSS STREET: APPROXIMATELY 99.59FT TO THE NEAREST CROSS STREET KNOWN AS LAMBS ROAD
APPROXIMATE UPSET: $407,000.00
OCCUPANCY STATUS: BORROWER OCCUPIED
THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF GLOUCESTER COUNTY IN DEED BOOK 6434, AT PAGE 196
PURSUANT TO A MUNICIPAL TAX SEARCH DATED JANUARY 28, 2026
SUBJECT TO:
2026 3RD QUARTER TAXES DUE 8/1/2026, $2,857.89 OPEN; GRACE PERIOD EXTENDED TO 9/8/2026
2026 4TH QUARTER TAXES DUE 11/1/2026, $2,857.89 OPEN
SEWER: ACCT. 2238 0, 6/1/2026-8/31/2026, $117.80 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $459.20 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
SUBJECT TO FINAL READING
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $356,868.51
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: September 9, 2026
Firm: HILL WALLACK LLP
Judgement Date: 11/15/2023
